card.title: How much, Cost, Money
card.tagline: Apprenez à demander un prix simplement.

song.title: How Much Cost Money
song.description: Une chanson pratique pour apprendre à demander un prix.
lyrics: How much, how much does it cost,
How much, how much does it cost,
A little coin, a gentle price,
How much money, once or twice.
How much does it cost today,
How much, how much does it cost,
